task_description: Complete/extend the admin management of match EVENTS and FORMATIONS (lineups) for the JSO platform. Backend: extend the MatchEvent entity (nullable SecondaryPlayerName + Team columns), add an UPDATE endpoint for events, add a versioned PostgreSQL migration, keep lineup GET/PUT and audit on all writes, preserve public read contracts. Frontend admin (AdminApp.jsx): add edit + new fields to the events editor and add a formations (lineup) editor, in French, with loading/empty/error states. Admin routes stay under [Authorize(Roles="SuperAdmin,ClubAdmin,MatchManager")]. Branch: feat/admin-match-events-lineups.
